translated_title: Mexico Has Recovered 3,770 Pieces of Cultural Heritage from Other Countries So Far This Term
original_title: México ha recuperado 3 mil 770 piezas de patrimonio cultural de otros países en lo que va del sexenio

meta_description: Most were returned by the United States; the standout is a Mixtec turquoise-mosaic skull recovered from a Dutch museum, among 17,778 pieces in recent years.
